_note: Each pack lists skills to install per project, plugins it needs, and the default working mode. Skill names come from each repo; if an install fails, run `npx skills add <source> --list` to see current names and update this file. "when" says when Claude uses the skill; /kickoff copies it into the project's CLAUDE.md. "optionalSkills" are installed only when the spec picks the option named in their "when". "mcpServers" go in the project's .mcp.json (project scope, never global); "config" is copied as is.

web-vanilla.description: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS sites, GSAP animation, scrollytelling, portfolios

skills.when: Writing or reviewing any GSAP tween, ease or stagger, and reduced-motion handling
Sequencing several animation steps (intros, multi-step reveals)
Scroll-driven animation: reveals, scrubbed or pinned sections
Before launch, and whenever motion janks: check transforms, layout thrash and mobile FPS
Review step before launch (next to DESIGN_CHECKLIST.md), and before /handover: run it on the built site and show findings by severity before fixing
At the brainstorm (design direction in the spec) and at the screenshot checkpoint after the first full page

creative.description: Experimental, interactive sites (Astro, GSAP, Lenis, three.js, React islands only where state needs it): portfolios, art and editorial sites

skills.when: Writing or reviewing any GSAP tween, ease or stagger, and gsap.matchMedia() for reduced motion
Sequencing several animation steps (intros, multi-step reveals, page transitions)
Pinned, scrubbed or scroll-linked sections, and syncing ScrollTrigger with Lenis
SplitText, Flip, Draggable, Inertia or Observer: text effects, layout transitions, drag and pointer interactions
GSAP inside a React island or the Vite + React option (useGSAP, cleanup on unmount)
At the screenshot checkpoint, before launch, and whenever motion janks on the throttled phone profile
Setting up any three.js scene: renderer, camera, resize, render loop, disposal
Custom shader effects (image distortion, grain, transitions) and shader debugging
Images or video as textures: colour space, sizing, memory
Pointer, drag or hover in a three.js scene
A scene misses the performance budget, janks, or before launch on any page with WebGL
At the brainstorm, for each Explore prototype, and at the screenshot checkpoint. STYLE.md (or the client's brief) pins the direction, which the skill says always wins
Review step before launch (next to DESIGN_CHECKLIST.md), and before /handover: run it on the built site and show findings by severity before fixing

optionalSkills.when: Only if the spec picks Vite + React with React Three Fiber and drei
Only if the spec picks Vite + React: React performance and bundle review

astro-docs.when: Before writing Astro config, integrations, islands, image or routing code: current Astro docs (official, by the Astro team)

context7.when: Current docs for libraries without an installed skill (Lenis, drei, Astro integrations), or to check a version-specific API

chrome-devtools.when: Performance budget checks (trace with 4x CPU throttling and Fast 4G), console errors and layout debugging, at the screenshot checkpoint and before launch. --isolated uses a temporary Chrome profile, never the personal one

shopify.description: Custom Shopify themes in Liquid, e-commerce sites and redesigns

skills.when: Writing or reviewing any Liquid section, block, snippet or theme setting
Review step before launch (next to DESIGN_CHECKLIST.md), and before /handover: run it on the built site and show findings by severity before fixing
At the brainstorm (design direction in the spec) and at the screenshot checkpoint after the first full page
